Walking through the city streets at dawn offers a unique perspective on urban life. The sidewalks are nearly empty, save for a few early joggers and delivery trucks making their rounds. Shop windows reflect the golden light of sunrise, creating fleeting moments of beauty between concrete towers. Coffee shops begin to stir, their baristas preparing for the morning rush that will transform these quiet blocks into rivers of commuters. Birds sing from fire escapes and windowsills, their melodies competing with the distant rumble of subway trains below. The city breathes differently at this hour.
